feature_contract.goal: Protect R84 central C993 lens flare physical left-to-right stereo source identity across a reentrant native game draw, preventing a new flare/ring/foreign object or stale shader from borrowing the original centre right-eye projection.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact direct D3A5/C993 central sun R84 R33 stereo physical GPU submission only; preserve CABE outer halos, SkyGlow, F11/ESC, +TIME, GOAL, car shadows, original input/FFB, R26_SAFE rollback and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Canonical EXE D3A5 enters the C993 exact world billboard producer scope and uploads source-owned original c64 WVP via the game hook.
R84 R30 builds centre left and right head-relative eye constants before R33 physically invokes the original left GPU Draw; nested draw may change producer, shader epoch, pose or draw serial.

R84 R33 either submits the same proven C993 source to the second eye or restores original native c64, marks stereo frame unusable and does not replay the left Draw; OpenXR host accepts no falsely completed two-eye frame.
subcomponents: Capture exact centre producer call, physical draw serial, pose sequence and shader epoch/identity before and after real native left-eye Draw, rejecting a changed or unknown source.
Restore original c64 and invalidate incomplete stereo instead of submitting foreign right-eye geometry; compile and execute portable positive/negative regressions as part of mandatory host build.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: C993 producer through R84 physical left/right GPU Draw
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only an unchanged exact original C993 producer, shader and pose may reuse prepared right-eye constants after a native left-eye submission.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Nested game draw, original shader state and outer halos
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Changed producer/draw/shader/pose after left submission never enters right-eye Draw, restores native original WVP and maintains original left HRESULT while invalidating the incomplete stereo frame.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 x86 game, x64 OpenXR host, package and Windows gate matrix
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain, Inspector and Full Source Impact compile and verify on unchanged source; Quest3 optics remain UNTESTED unless physically verified.

diagnosis.root_cause: R33TryHud builds and uploads both eye C993 matrices but invokes a native original left-eye game Draw with potential renderer reentrancy; previously no source identity recheck before dispatching the prepared right-eye matrix.
diagnosis.original_evidence: The actual R84 stereo_renderer_r33.cpp R33TryHud performs actualDraw() for the left eye and then submits the right-eye pass without re-sampling the physical C993 source/shader identity; R30's prior raw c64 proof predates the left physical draw.
source_trace: Original D3A5 producer tags direct C993 and game c64 upload as centre world billboard.
R30 proves the raw stock WVP and builds asymmetric headset eye constants.
R33's raw left Draw is a native callback boundary; pre/post centre source stamp now gates subsequent right-eye submission.
alternatives_rejected: No C993 E8 reinstall, no generic alpha/WorldBillboard widening, no global D3DX Flush, no SkyGlow/halo modification and no claim that a C993 optical root cause has been verified on HMD.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Original left eye uses the native C993 Draw; right eye is submitted only with the same direct-centre call, shader generation, draw serial and pose. Source mutation marks the stereo frame incomplete and restores original game c64.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Integrated R84 R33 direct draw guard checks exact source before and after native left Draw and fails closed without a second game Draw if reentered.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable x64 host lens-upload transaction smoke extended with unchanged and eight producer/shader/draw/pose/invalid negatives; still awaiting exact-SHA CI.

next_action: Resolve exact-SHA CI; if successful record C6 separately without duplicate task/feature score. Quest3/VDXR runtime acceptance stays NEED_HMD_TEST.
